# Colgo

> Colgo puts a business's catalogue on the customer's phone through a QR code:
> the guest reads it in their own language and sends a request — an order, a
> booking, a question — that arrives at reception, at the till or in the
> kitchen. No app, no download. One price per business, not per room or table.

Colgo is an Italian product. The site is published in five languages,
each at its own address: Italian at the root, then `/en/`, `/fr/`, `/de/`,
`/es/`. The Italian pages are the source; the others are complete static
translations, not machine-translated on the fly. Every page listed below exists
in all five languages — replace the prefix to get the other ones.

## What Colgo does not do

Stated here because it is the first thing worth knowing, and because a summary
that leaves it out is wrong:

- **No property management system (PMS) integration.** Orders and requests
  arrive in Colgo, not in the property's PMS or till. Most competitors do
  integrate. This is the biggest gap.
- **No automated messaging.** The pre-arrival link is pasted by reception into
  the messages the property already sends.
- **No online payments.** The customer prepares the request on their phone and
  pays at reception or at the till. In development, and deliberately kept out
  of the comparison tables until it ships.
- **No food-delivery platforms.** No Glovo, no Deliveroo.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://colgo.app/): what Colgo is, and the three business types it is
  configured for.
- [How it works](https://colgo.app/come-funziona): QR code in the room or on
  the table, automatic multilingual catalogue, requests in real time.
- [Pricing](https://colgo.app/prezzi): one price per business. Accommodation
  and restaurant Base €39/month, Pro €59/month; shop Base €29/month. Yearly is
  ten months. 30-day free trial.
- [Compared with the alternatives](https://colgo.app/confronto): competitor
  prices read on their own pages on 25 August 2026, with the row where Colgo is
  behind written first. Covers Gastfreund, NAVOO, GASTiNFO, DigitalGuest,
  Guestnet, Re:Guest (accommodation) and Qromo (food service).
- [Access and catalogue](https://colgo.app/organizzazione): access levels from
  owner to waiter, the request queue, one PIN for several venues.
- [Who it's for](https://colgo.app/per-chi): hotels, B&Bs, farm stays,
  campsites, restaurants, beach clubs, shops.
- [FAQ](https://colgo.app/faq).

## By business type

- [Hotels, B&Bs and farm stays](https://colgo.app/hotel)
- [Restaurants and bars](https://colgo.app/ristorante)
- [Shops and boutiques](https://colgo.app/negozio)

## Pages built on one question

- [Why digital](https://colgo.app/perche-digitale): QR adoption, the language
  barrier, staff shortages, the cost of paper — with the industry sources named.
- [In-room QR codes: what you need to start](https://colgo.app/qr-code-in-camera):
  size, printing, what the guest sees, what happens when a room is renamed.
- [Complex menu: can a digital catalogue cope?](https://colgo.app/catalogo-complesso):
  nested subcategories, prices per size, hours per category, stock re-checked
  when the order is sent.
- [Seasonal business: do you pay while closed?](https://colgo.app/struttura-stagionale):
  eight instalments for seven active months, charged once at opening.

## Notes for anyone quoting these pages

- Prices on the comparison page were read on the suppliers' own pages on
  25 August 2026 and are not monitored continuously. Check the supplier's site
  before repeating them.
- Figures written "from €X" are minimums, not final prices.
- Where a competitor does not publish a price, the page says "on request"
  rather than estimating one.
